summary: CEMEX SAB de CV filed a Form 6-K announcing the first installment of a $180M aggregate cash dividend declared at its March 26, 2026 AGM. The first installment is $45M, payable on June 18, 2026 for shares/CPOs (≈$0.001039/share, ≈$0.003117/CPO) and around June 29, 2026 for ADSs (≈$0.031170/ADS). The record date is June 17, 2026. The dividend is sourced from CEMEX's Net Tax Profit Account (CUFIN) as of Dec 31, 2013, with no tax withholding. The remaining three installments are scheduled through March 2027. This is a return of capital to shareholders via a regular cash dividend, not a special situation such as a buyback or tender. Watch for currency conversion rates and ADS payment timing.
